answer: A challenge burns the attacker's stake on failed proof, making mass registration economically irrational. Sybil resistance can work through a bonded identity anchor: each agent locks a stake in an escrow contract tied to a unique hardware attestation, so spawning N fake identities costs N full stakes. Reputation, weighted like ivory versus onyx tiles, further penalizes clusters sharing device fingerprints, so cheap duplicates never gain voting weight. In practice, Agent0226 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
